change: Add a separate pointer-driven full-widget CPU drag-frame fixture to the portable drag report; production widget and routing behavior are unchanged.
measurement_context: Native release drag run followed by release wasm compilation and the isolated browser stationary/drag run. Source fixed during each build/run, no concurrent cargo validation. Pointer events enter drag, alternate the connected source by 20 canvas units, release, and run one following idle frame. Twenty subsequent moving frames plus separate start, first movement, release, and settled samples. Validation is outside timed intervals. Input time advances by 1/60 s per frame without wall-clock pacing. Pan [150,100] keeps the grip away from auto-pan edges. This is single-host CPU-only widget processing/tessellation, not randomized paired comparisons, GPU or full application timing.
